chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far Al-Qurashi Al-Razzaz narrated to me from his uncle Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Muthanna, from Sadir, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say: Verily, Allah has placed the killing of the children of the prophets from the previous nations in the hands of those who were conceived illegitimately.

key_terms.أَوْلَادِ زِنًا: children of illegitimate union / those conceived through zina

ai.seo_question: Who killed the children of the prophets according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) elucidates a divine decree wherein the slayers of the prophets' offspring from previous nations were born from illegitimate unions (zina), a principle often applied to identify the lineage of the killers of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) and Yahya ibn Zakariyya (a.s.). This narration underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the spiritual and genealogical purity of the Ahl al-Bayt by contrasting their martyrdom with the specific lineage of their adversaries.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far Al-Qurashi Al-Razzāz narrated to me from his uncle Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, from ‘Ali ibn Nu’mān, from Muthannā, from Sadīr, who said:
I heard Abā Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) say: Verily Allāh has placed the killing of the children of the prophets from the previous nations in the hands of those who were conceived illegitimately.
